monitor.title: Request monitoring
monitor.reconnectNotice: The live feed is unavailable. Displayed observations are frozen; reconnect to restore current data.
monitor.waiting: Waiting for an authorized monitoring snapshot…
monitor.staleNotice: Some worker heartbeats are missing. Counts may be incomplete.
monitor.truncatedNotice: Request details reached the retention limit; these statistics describe the retained details.
monitor.flowDescription: Middleware runs inside each worker. Highlighted rows represent observed in-flight requests.
monitor.asgi: Each worker runs its own ASGI app
monitor.returnPath: Response returns through its original worker
monitor.dispatchNote: Connections stay with the accepting worker. Middleware does not dispatch across workers.
monitor.inFlightNote: In-flight counts concurrent requests, not execution threads.
monitor.tableNote: Completion means the final ASGI body/trailers were sent. The worker filter affects this table; cards summarize all retained requests.
monitor.restartNote: Unexpected replacements during this server run
monitor.resourceNote: CPU is relative to one core and can exceed 100%. Memory is RSS. Transactions count logical application sessions, not active SQL statements. Health reflects lifespan heartbeats.
monitor.cycleNote: Observation cycle: {{seconds}} s · unchanged snapshots are not pushed
monitor.workerTotalsNote: Requests and failures are cumulative since each Worker started; failed requests include HTTP 4xx/5xx and interrupted responses.

overview.title: Server monitoring overview
overview.description: FastAPI service health, request trends and login distribution at a glance.
overview.dateHint: Select 1–93 days, including both dates. Future dates are unavailable. Dates use Asia/Taipei.
overview.noCompleteData: No complete daily observations in this period
overview.healthHelp: Availability is successful HTTP, Redis and database probes divided by observed probes. Missing minutes remain unknown. SLO is evaluated only when the entire completed period is covered. This is sampled availability, not continuous uptime.
overview.geoDescription: Estimated from login IP · Each account is assigned to its last login region in this period.
overview.geoHelp: Each account is counted once for the entire period. Country percentages include accounts with unknown locations in their denominator, so known-country shares may total less than 100%.
overview.noKnownLocations: These accounts have no resolved login location
overview.noLogins: No signed-in accounts in this period
overview.unmapped: {{count}} users belong to countries without a map position
overview.incomplete: Partial collection coverage; missing observations are unknown.
overview.trafficHelp: Counts stored application HTTP requests, including errors. Monitoring endpoints are excluded. This does not measure page views or unique visitors. Dashed points are partial observations; missing days are not treated as zero.
overview.workersLive: Live workers · independent of date range
overview.workerHelp: Worker status comes from lifespan heartbeats. CPU is relative to one core and can exceed 100%; memory is shown in MiB. Restart counts cover the current supervisor run. Service health uses separate HTTP, Redis and database probes.
overview.refreshNote: Traffic and health history are saved every {{seconds}}s; cached aggregates can lag another 60s.
